digest.component_or_area: verify config schema / cross-ticket overlap detector
propositions: Rename the config field verify.overlap_enabled to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets to name the advisory link-suggestion output rather than the internal overlap mechanism.
Keep both the old TOML key and old env var working forever as permanent aliases, with the canonical key winning silently when both are set.
The feature is opt-in, LLM-backed, advisory (never blocks a claim or close), and its cost scales with tracker size.
Add a docs/config.md inventory entry, since the key is currently undocumented except in ADR 0037.
Register two _permanent deprecation rows (cfg:verify.overlap_enabled and env:REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED) whose messages say 'permanent alias' not 'scheduled for removal'.
Update only the two in-source readers plus this repo's own rebar.toml, leaving the four back-compat sites as the sole surviving occurrences of the old name.
